create_ObjectGoalNavEpisode: create an ObjectGoalNavEpisode with object_category to define navigation goals for a specific scene
create_ObjectViewLocation: create an ObjectViewLocation with agent_state and iou to describe navigable viewpoints around an object goal
create_ObjectGoal: create an ObjectGoal with object_id, object_name, and view_points to specify a navigation target object
use_ObjectGoalSensor_get_observation: use ObjectGoalSensor get_observation to return the task category ID or object ID for an episode
register_ObjectNavigationTask: register the ObjectNavigationTask with the Habitat registry to define an ObjectNav-v1 navigation task
